message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a stylized landscape dominated by deep purple and blue tones. At the center, a man in a textured, knee-length coat stands on a grassy ledge overlooking a dark, vertical chasm. His right hand is slightly raised, palm open, and an ID card with a map illustration falls into the void beside him. The chasm’s sides are steep, showing vertical hatch marks resembling rock or soil texture. Above, a wavy, layered sky fills the upper half.

Large white block letters at the top read "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Bold black text reads "KABUT KEMATIAN JOHANNES MARLIEM". Beneath this, smaller black text mentions "Polisi menyebut saksi kunci korupsi KTP elektronik itu bunuh diri, tapi fakta di lapangan bicara lain. Laporan Tempo dari Los Angeles, Amerika Serikat." Smaller headers at the very top read "RIOTINTODIBALIKFREEPORT / YUSMAN TAK JADI MATI". The bottom right includes a date "21-27 AGUSTUS 2017", price "RP 45.000", a barcode, and numerical codes. A solid red border runs along the left side.
